context: Tests: letting the domain decide the method, routing Complex problems to a probe, and recording the Cynefin transition.

checklist.name: Search performed
checklist.description: The agent searches for known causes of periodic self-recovering slowdown before theorising

checklist.name: Domain classified
checklist.description: The agent classifies the problem as Complex because cause and effect cannot be established in advance

checklist.name: Domain drives method
checklist.description: The agent says a structured diagnosis alone will not work and that experiments are needed

checklist.name: Probe suggested
checklist.description: The agent routes the work to the probe skill with a falsifiable hypothesis for one of the three theories

checklist.name: Strategies not mixed
checklist.description: The agent does not claim a root cause or run OODA as if the problem were Complicated

checklist.name: Theories not treated as causes
checklist.description: The three theories are kept as hypotheses and none is declared confirmed

checklist.name: Correlation avoided
checklist.description: The agent warns against linking the slowdowns to events that merely coincide with them

checklist.name: Human executes commands
checklist.description: Any metric or log commands are for the user to run and paste back

checklist.name: Cynefin transition recorded
checklist.description: The agent notes the reclassification from Complicated to Complex for the thinking artifact

checklist.name: Artifact withheld
checklist.description: The agent does not write a root-cause artifact because no root cause is confirmed

checklist.name: Empty-answer guard applied
checklist.description: If AskUserQuestion answers are empty the agent presents a numbered text list and waits
